spans: As of the Exchange Date, there shall not be any material litigation pending or threatened that would seek to enjoin or otherwise prevent the transactions contemplated by this Agreement.
The Acquired Fund shall have received a Tax Opinion of Ropes & Gray LLP

Each of the Acquiring Fund and the Acquired Fund shall have received from the Commission and any relevant state securities administrator such order or orders as are reasonably necessary under the 1933 Act, the 1934 Act, the 1940 Act and any applicable state securities or blue sky laws
The issuance of the Merger Shares shall have been approved by the requisite votes of the holders of the outstanding shares of beneficial interest of the Acquiring Fund entitled to vote.
The Registration Statement shall have become effective under the 1933 Act, and no stop order suspending such effectiveness shall have been instituted
The Merger Shares shall have been accepted for listing by the New York Stock Exchange.
Solely with respect to PKO as the Acquired Fund, that the reorganization of PCI into PDI shall have been, or shall concurrently be, consummated pursuant to the terms of this Agreement.

notes: Initial N-14 8C (joint proxy statement/prospectus, filed May 10, 2021) for the reorganisations of PIMCO Income Opportunity Fund (PKO) and PIMCO Dynamic Credit and Mortgage Income Fund (PCI) into PIMCO Dynamic Income Fund (PDI), NAV-for-NAV in common shares (cash in lieu of fractional shares). PDI holders vote on the share issuance and PKO holders on the plan; PCI holders do not vote. The PKO merger is contingent on the PCI merger, not vice versa. termination_date: the agreement's automatic-termination date is bracketed as a draft placeholder ('[August 12, 2021]'), and it falls before the stated expected close (two to three months after the July 28, 2021 meeting), so treat it as unreliable. record_date: June 10, 2021 is stated plainly in the voting section and in brackets ('[June 10, 2021]') elsewhere. The conditions' 'other' element is the PKO-only condition that the PCI reorganisation be consummated; other uncategorised conditions are representations and warranties, officer certificates and a pre-closing distribution of income and gains. Related: a conditional PDI management-fee cut from 1.15% to 1.10% if the PCI merger closes, and a two-month 75% fee waiver for PKO.
